en_title: Nintendo Reveals Development Team Behind The Legend of Zelda: Ocarina of Time Remake
cn_title: Nintendo公布The Legend of Zelda: Ocarina of Time重制版开发团队
opus_summary: Nintendo在Ask the Developer访谈中确认，《The Legend of Zelda: Ocarina of Time》重制版由其Entertainment Planning & Development Production Group No. 3负责。游戏将于11月5日登陆Switch 2，Eiji Aonuma表示他基本让开发者做出他们认为真正必要的改动。

paragraphs.en: Nintendo has revealed the development team responsible for creating The Legend of Zelda: Ocarina of Time remake .
paragraphs.cn: Nintendo公布了负责制作塞尔达传说 时之笛重制版的开发团队。

paragraphs.en: The Super Mario Bros. company typically keeps its cards pretty close to its chest when it comes to the behind-the-scenes details for its biggest releases. The Legend of Zelda series is no exception, but Nintendo did offer a peek behind the curtain as part of an Ocarina of Time remake installment in its Ask the Developer Q&A series.
paragraphs.cn: 这家推出Super Mario Bros.的公司在涉及旗下最重要作品的幕后细节时，通常都守口如瓶。The Legend of Zelda系列也不例外，但Nintendo确实在Ask the Developer问答系列的一期Ocarina of Time重制版访谈中，让人们一窥幕后。

paragraphs.en: Fans have speculated who might be behind the Nintendo Switch 2 reimagining of an all-time classic since it was announced. While some believed Xenoblade series developer Monolith Soft might be leading the charge, for example, the interview confirmed that it's actually Nintendo's Entertainment Planning & Development (EDP) Production Group No. 3 that's responsible for The Legend of Zelda: Ocarina of Time remake.
paragraphs.cn: 自公布以来，粉丝们一直在猜测是谁在为Switch 2重新打造这款历代经典作品。例如，有些人认为Xenoblade系列开发商Monolith Soft可能在主导开发，但这次访谈证实，负责塞尔达传说 时之笛重制版的实际上是Nintendo的Entertainment Planning & Development（EDP）Production Group No. 3。

paragraphs.en: Featured in the first interview chapter are franchise producer Eiji Aonuma and series directing veteran Hidemaro Fujibayashi, with EDP Production Group No. 3's HokWai Ng, Aya Shida, Hiroki Taguchi, and Masato Ohashi also listed as interviewees to be featured in future highlights. In other words, the core team behind one of the most highly-anticipated games of the last few years is the same group behind most The Legend of Zelda projects from the last 30 years.
paragraphs.cn: 第一章访谈的受访者包括该系列制作人青沼英二和资深系列总监藤林秀麿，EDP Production Group No. 3的HokWai Ng、Aya Shida、Hiroki Taguchi和Masato Ohashi也被列为受访者，将在之后的访谈重点内容中出场。换句话说，这款近几年最受期待的游戏之一，其核心团队正是过去30年里负责大多数The Legend of Zelda项目的同一团队。

paragraphs.en: Longtime fans of the original Nintendo 64 game (or even its 2011 Nintendo 3DS remake) who have feared the Switch 2 version of the story could tarnish its reputation can probably rest easy knowing it was in experienced hands. That said, it is always possible another team like Monolith Soft could have chipped in as a support developer, though we likely won't know the full list of team members until we have a better look at those credits in a few days.
paragraphs.cn: 原版Nintendo 64游戏（甚至是其2011年Nintendo 3DS重制版）的长期粉丝如果担心Switch 2版的故事可能会损害它的声誉，在得知游戏由经验丰富的团队负责后，或许可以放心了。话虽如此，也始终存在Monolith Soft之类的其他团队作为协助开发者参与其中的可能性，不过我们可能要等到几天后更仔细地查看制作人员名单，才会知道完整的团队成员名单。

paragraphs.en: The Legend of Zelda: Ocarina of Time remake launches for Switch 2 November 5. Although it was made by the same hands that have helped keep the classic fantasy franchise kicking for decades, that doesn't mean the developers weren't willing to experiment where they could. During the interview, Aonuma explained that he tried to "basically let the developers make whatever changes they genuinely felt were necessary."
paragraphs.cn: 塞尔达传说 时之笛重制版将于11月5日登陆Switch 2。尽管制作这款游戏的团队多年来一直帮助这个经典奇幻系列保持活力，但这并不意味着开发者不愿在力所能及的地方进行尝试。访谈中，Aonuma解释说，他试图「基本上让开发者做出他们真心认为有必要的任何改动」。

paragraphs.en: "I wanted the team to make The Legend of Zelda: Ocarina of Time their own, and to follow through on their own ideas about what the game should be," he added. "That said, I did deliver my fair share of lectures along the way. (Laughs) I took a step back to observe how the younger members of the development team would reimagine The Legend of Zelda: Ocarina of Time using the insights and answers they had arrived at on their own."
paragraphs.cn: 他补充道：「我希望团队能将塞尔达传说 时之笛变成属于他们自己的作品，并贯彻他们自己对游戏应该是什么样子的想法。话虽如此，在这个过程中，我也没少训话。（笑）我退居幕后，观察开发团队的年轻成员如何运用他们自己得出的见解和答案，重新构想塞尔达传说 时之笛。」

paragraphs.en: Fujibayashi added that, from his point of view, it was important for the team to have a clear outline for what would and wouldn't be changed from the Nintendo 64 game early on.
paragraphs.cn: Fujibayashi补充说，在他看来，团队在早期就明确列出相较于Nintendo 64游戏哪些内容会改动、哪些不会改动，这一点很重要。

paragraphs.en: "For people like us, who know both the original The Legend of Zelda: Ocarina of Time and the recent 3D Legend of Zelda games, there's no shortage of things we’d like to say when it comes to designing a game," he said. "(Laughs) That’s why I took a step back and supported the team from a broader perspective by helping them clarify the things they needed to be mindful of when designing the game."
paragraphs.cn: 他说：「对于像我们这样既了解原版塞尔达传说 时之笛，也了解近期3D Legend of Zelda游戏的人来说，一谈到游戏设计，总有说不完的话。（笑）所以我退后一步，从更宏观的角度支持团队，帮助他们明确设计游戏时需要注意的事项。」

paragraphs.en: Despite having a good plan for how Nintendo and EDP Production Group No. 3 would tackle The Legend of Zelda: Ocarina of Time remake from the get-go, Aonuma recently admitted that he's still a bit nervous to see how fans will respond . Meanwhile, Google recently launched a time-traveling Easter Egg to help build up hype for this week's new Switch 2 game.
paragraphs.cn: 尽管从一开始就对Nintendo和EDP Production Group No. 3如何着手制作塞尔达传说 时之笛重制版有了周全的计划，Aonuma最近还是承认，他对粉丝会如何回应仍有些紧张。与此同时，Google最近推出了一个时间旅行彩蛋，为本周推出的这款Switch 2新游戏造势。
